description: Defines the interface for Camera3OutputStream in Android camera service, including methods for stream configuration, buffer management, and stream properties.

classes.name: Camera3OutputStreamInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing a single camera output stream, including configuration, buffer handling, and stream properties.

classes.name: StreamSet
classes.description: Helper class for managing a synchronized collection of stream IDs and their associated stream instances.

methods.name: setTransform
methods.description: Set the transformation applied to the output stream, such as rotation or mirroring.

methods.name: isVideoStream
methods.description: Check if the stream is used for video encoding.

methods.name: isConsumerConfigurationDeferred
methods.description: Determine if the consumer configuration of the stream is deferred.

methods.name: setConsumers
methods.description: Assign consumer surfaces to the output stream.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detach an unused buffer from the stream, returning the buffer and fence file descriptor.

methods.name: getSurfaceId
methods.description: Retrieve the surface ID for a given surface.

methods.name: getUniqueSurfaceIds
methods.description: Get unique surface IDs for current surfaces, supporting surface sharing.

methods.name: updateStream
methods.description: Update the output surfaces and related info for the stream.

methods.name: getPhysicalCameraId
methods.description: Get the physical camera ID associated with the stream.

methods.name: setBatchSize
methods.description: Set the batch size for buffer operations, mainly for video streams.

methods.name: onMinDurationChanged
methods.description: Notify that the minimum frame duration or frame rate has changed.

methods.name: setStreamUseCase
methods.description: Modify the use case for this output stream.
